summary:
FMLink promotes the 2026 International Federation of Healthcare Engineering (IFHE) World Congress, which for the first time will be co-located with the Healthcare Design (HCD) Conference + Expo. The event runs Oct. 17-20, 2026 at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans. It is hosted by the Association of Medical Facility Professionals and produced by Forge (formerly Emerald) in partnership with IFHE.

The stated value of the co-location is that facility, engineering and operations professionals can gather in one venue alongside the designers and architects who shape healthcare environments, bridging two audiences that normally attend separate events.

Program details: the IFHE World Congress track offers more than 30 sessions covering engineering strategy, operational readiness, facility planning and global healthcare perspectives, with content purpose-built for healthcare engineering and facilities professionals. Facility managers wanting broader access can buy the combined IFHE and HCD Full Conference Pass, which opens up HCD's 110-plus session program in addition to the IFHE track.

The joint full conference pass also includes all keynotes and networking events, such as welcome receptions and the HCD networking party, plus breakfasts and lunches.

The piece closes with a promotional offer: $300 off the joint full conference pass using promo code MCMORROW300, with registration through HCD Expo. The item is essentially an event listing and registration promotion rather than analysis, and carries no independent data, research findings or commentary on workplace operations, hybrid policy or workplace technology.
